inj.t: Out (Injured Reserve): Head coach Marco Sturm announced Saturday that Hagens (back) is expected to miss multiple weeks, per Jack Studley of Boston Hockey Now.
Out (Injured Reserve): Edvinsson (contract dispute) is on the Red Wings' injured, non-roster list, per the NHL media site Wednesday.
Out (Injured Reserve): Johansson (undisclosed) will be with the Red Wings for their upcoming four-game road trip, Ansar Khan of MLive.com reports Friday.
Out (Injured Reserve): Demidov (foot) skated Tuesday and could resume training with the team next week, Patrick Friolet of RDS reports.
Out (Injured Reserve): Montembeault (lower body) is considered day-to-day, according to Renaud Lavoie of TVA Sports on Saturday.
Out (Injured Reserve): Mantha (throat) was placed on long-term injured reserve by the Devils on Wednesday, retroactive to Nov. 7.
Out (Injured Reserve): The Devils placed Kovacevic (ankle) on injured reserve Friday, retroactive to Nov. 10.
